name: apa
title: APA parking
fetch_instructions:
- The recording is supplied as a local mcap path in the case packet (current deployment: user provides the path or a Jira key that another process has already materialized to disk).
- Do not download, install, or request network access yourself; if the recording is not on disk, stop and report the minimum missing input.
routing_hints: Perception: obstacle existence, identity, pose, shape, validity, tracking continuity.
Decision: collision input/result, clearance, stop distance, arbitration, state transition.
Planning: target slot, candidate/selected trajectory, replanning, geometric clearance.
Control: planned versus commanded versus measured pose, steering, velocity, tracking error.
Cross-domain: only a named producer-consumer disagreement, timing/order issue, or runtime/configuration boundary.

domains.check_aspects: source availability, object identity/association, validity/freshness, pose/shape/class, frame/unit conversion, filtering, and representation conversion as applicable
domains.evidence_guidance: Include concise evidence for obstacle existence, ID continuity, class, pose, shape, validity, freshness, frame, and consumed representation only when they affect the current hop.

domains.check_aspects: bad/stale input, frame/unit conversion, policy, state/configuration, numerical behavior, fallback/default, timing/order, and ownership only as the current hop requires
domains.boundary_locations: checker transformation, gate/state, arbitration, fallback, or output publication
domains.domain_extra_method: 7. For stateful behavior, use an evaluation truth table only for the selected window. For geometry, verify frames, reference point, footprint/inflation, sampling, and threshold only when implicated.
domains.evidence_guidance: Report first bad input, first bad decision, first bad output, and symptom separately. Classify collision behavior as missed obstacle, policy-accepted clearance, late detection, or insufficient evidence only when supported. Include clearance, stop distance, confidence, or filter effects only with valid frame/unit/clock.

domains.check_aspects: target slot, candidate generation, feasibility filters, ranking/selection, replanning triggers, geometric clearance, and upstream decision/perception inputs only as the current hop requires
domains.boundary_locations: candidate generation, feasibility, ranking, selection, replanning, gate, fallback, or published output
domains.evidence_guidance: Separate candidate generation, feasibility, ranking, selection, replanning, gate, fallback, and published output. Include trajectory counts, clearance, or slot geometry only with valid frame/unit/clock.

domains.check_aspects: planned versus commanded versus measured pose, steering, velocity, gear, tracking error, actuator limits, and timing/order only as the current hop requires
domains.boundary_locations: reference resampling, feedback/feedforward terms, limiters, gear/state gating, or command publication
domains.evidence_guidance: Compare planned, commanded, and measured quantities at the same clock before attributing divergence. Include steering/velocity/tracking-error values only with valid frame/unit/clock.
